summary: Allen publicly supported the 2019 deletion of anti-Israel language—settler colonialism, right of return, Golan Heights—from California Democratic Party resolutions and voted Aye on AB 715, which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. He visited Kibbutz K'far Aza in December 2023, framing the conflict around October 7 while identifying as Jewish Caucus Chair. California Jewish Democrats (the renamed Democrats for Israel California) gave him their strongest-tier support; Vote for Peace opposed his candidacy.
